items.title: Land isolated-clone runtime
items.exit_criteria: Main installs, tests and packages without a sibling TheHub checkout.

items.title: Reconcile workspace policy
items.exit_criteria: One current workspace policy remains and is aligned with TheHub authority.

items.title: Supersede or refresh GUI parity candidate
items.exit_criteria: Current main has the parity ratchet and reachability evidence, or #67 is closed as superseded.

items.title: Run recurring source discovery and candidate intake
items.exit_criteria: A reproducible governed run records source accounting and routes real candidates without modifying master.

items.title: Grow corpus through reviewed promotion
items.exit_criteria: Reviewed candidates are promoted individually with validation and lineage receipts.

items.title: Backfill missing case coordinates
items.exit_criteria: Missing coordinates are resolved or explicitly unresolvable with source, method, precision and review state.
